profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Raytheon Technologies

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led a small team consisting of three software engineers through the development lifecycle of a feature of the system; Product design, development, and testing of the developed feature
Kept track of development efforts for a small team using Agile methodologies by using sprints, user stories and tasks using JIRA software
Improved test automation suite by developing automated tests for HMI’s in the software using Eggplant
Developed Test Harness in Java to test software functional capabilities delivered for each software cycle
Worked closely with Software Integration team to provide solutions to software failing to meet technical requirements
Analyzed and Improved functionality and performance of User Interface Software
Performed continuous code reviews of deliveries to ensure quality of product

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Configured active directory to prevent users from modifying certain attributes that are used by the software application to authenticate a user’s role and permissions within the software
Developed an automated performance tool in Java that can send variations of JMS message loads for performance testing with a click of a button
Developed Automated functional tests in Java using Cucumber test tool that would test the environments features to ensure that the software application would run once deployed to that environment
Developed Automated functional tests in Java using Cucumber test tool to test different features of the software application
Successfully helped integrate our software baseline to run in an AWS Cloud deployed environment

positions.title: NAS TLM Solution Center Intern
positions.description: Performed Remote Application upgrades in Windows Based (different versions such as XP, 2003 Server, Vista, Windows 7) environments with SQL or Sybase Database, and addressing any technical problems that may arise during these upgrades.
